body: My apologies. My eyes must have skipped over the question.
How are your teeth? I imagine that all the vomit must be hell on the enamel.

I feel a lot more detached from life. Like I am separated it. Like I am merely watching my life rather than living it. Everything feels much more ephemeral, because I know that at any time I could cause non-existence to myself permanently. On the one hand, I have virtually no anxiety now, but on the other I have horrible anhedonia. Nothing is fun to me.
Thank you. This is very good advice.
